name: ChoAppealSubmit
title: CHO Appeal Submit
description: Submit a post-adjudication claim appeal as a transaction Bundle. Accepts a Task conforming to cho-appeal-task, zero-to-many Communications conforming to cho-appeal-communication, and zero-to-many DocumentReferences conforming to cho-appeal-document-reference. Returns a transaction-response Bundle with assigned IDs. Runtime invariants (submitted Task must have status=requested; Communications and DocumentReferences must reference the submitted Task; transactional all-or-nothing semantics) are enforced at operation-invocation time by the implementing service. Authored by Cloud Health Office under its own canonical namespace; does not claim conformance to any external Implementation Guide. PR 1 authors this OperationDefinition; the operation itself is implemented in the appeals-service in a subsequent PR.

parameter.name: resource
parameter.documentation: A transaction Bundle containing exactly one Task conforming to cho-appeal-task, plus zero-to-many Communications and DocumentReferences. Bundle.type MUST be 'transaction'.

parameter.name: return
parameter.documentation: A transaction-response Bundle with persisted resource IDs and meta.lastUpdated populated. All-or-nothing semantics: if any resource fails to persist, no resources are persisted.
